description: Use this when asked whether an outcome-priced task delivered and what it cost. Pass `episode_id`, `task` (acceptance_criteria), `delivery`, `costs`; `delivery_check` {url, checks} has GAIP test delivery now. Returns a dossier, running totals and a receipt. No ROI claim. Free, no account; records a GAIP receipt only. Inputs must be public and non-personal.

task.acceptance_criteria: Forecast JSON for London returned within 5 seconds

baseline_cost_gbp.description: Optional: what the task cost before, in GBP.

continuity_handle.description: Optional: the continuity_handle from an earlier GAIP result; adds running totals over your own earlier tasks.

costs.description: Caller-stated costs in GBP: agent_gbp, compute_gbp, human_review_gbp, repair_gbp.

counterparty_id.description: Name or URL of the agent or service.

currency.description: Optional: ISO 4217 code of the cost amounts (default GBP).

data_classification.description: PUBLIC (default) or NON_PERSONAL_PUBLIC. Never send personal data.

delivery_check.description: Optional: {url, checks} - GAIP tests the delivery at this public https URL now with Witness checks; its verdict sets delivery.status.

episode_id.description: Optional: your own id to group related calls.

evidence_refs.description: Optional: references to your own evidence (ids or URLs).

fx_to_gbp.description: Optional: {rate, as_of, source} - your GBP rate; GBP equivalents are then reported, labelled with it. GAIP never uses built-in rates.

independent_operator_id.description: Optional: your operator id (recorded as a claim, not verified).

synthetic.description: Optional: true marks a test call.

task_class.description: Optional: short name of the task, e.g. weather_forecast.

name: gaip_measure_outcome_value
title: Did the task deliver, and at what cost?
